company.name: Apollo Agriculture
company.shortDescription: Apollo Agriculture is an agtech company that offers farmers access to agricultural inputs, financing, and advice.
company.description: Apollo Agriculture is an agtech company that offers farmers access to agricultural inputs, financing, and advice. Apollo helps farmers in emerging markets maximize their profits. The company uses agronomic machine learning, remote sensing, and mobile phones to deliver a customized package of credit, high-quality farm inputs, and advice that can double farm yields, starting in Kenya. Apollo assesses farmer credit risk and customizes each package to a farmer's specific location using satellite data, soil data, farmer behavior data, and crop yield models.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $2,134,393, or 2.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $1,090,000, representing 1.35% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,158,048 to $201,747,771, a 8.71x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 89 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
